chains.Q1_specific_loss: She loses trust in her own judgment at night — every gurgle becomes a danger scan; rest is impossible.
chains.Q2_villain: Opaque, weak feedback tools (bulb as sealed guess dispenser) that leave her diagnosing alone.
chains.Q3_dream: Standing by the bassinet without counting breaths — just resting.
chains.Q5_beats: Setup: careful new mum. Action: night checks, saline, bulb. Twist: problem was nose blockage she couldn't see, not her failing instincts. Verdict: visibility + clear ends the second-guessing whether to call the nurse line.
chains.Q6_product_fit: Transparent chamber and regulated suction show and remove mucus fast so she gets an answer instead of a guess.
chains.Q7_belief: Prove: night congestion can sound like can't-breathe; she isn't crazy for caring deeply.
Q8_headline_candidates: I kept checking his breathing and still couldn't trust myself.

chains.chosen_headline: I kept checking his breathing and still couldn't trust myself.
